title: A History of Modern Europe, 1792-1878
author: Charles Alan Fyffe

authorInfo.bio: Charles Alan Fyffe (1845–1892) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "A History of Modern Europe, 1792-1878" by Charles Alan Fyffe is a historical account that was first published in the late 19th century. The book narrates the major political, social, and military developments that shaped Europe from the onset of the Revolutionary War in 1792 through the late 19th century.
